derived.rain_total_mm: Sum of complete daily PRECTOTCORR (mm/day) over one-day intervals; total mm
derived.tmean_c: Arithmetic mean daily T2M; no field validation
derived.days_tmax_ge35c: Diagnostic >=35 C threshold only, not a validated crop damage rule
derived.days_rain_lt1mm: Diagnostic <1 mm/day threshold only; not root-zone drought
derived.monthly_reference: Mean/median/min/max of 11 yearly month totals; not 30-year climate normal
